newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Riksbank buys crowns for marks - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Riksbank buys crowns for marks - dealers.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, intervened in the market at about 1100 GMT on Tuesday, buying crown against mark at around 4.3150-4.3200, dealers said.
"We have seen a lot of incoming currencies and the Riksbank bought crowns at around 4.3150-4.32 to the mark at 1300 (local time)," said one dealer.
After the intervention the crown strengthened and was trading at 4.2900 to the mark in afternoon trade.
